Welcome to Pulse and Water College
Maximising Potential.
Results day is Thursday 20th August 2026.
Please collect your results between 9am and 11am.
Who are we?
Pulse and Water College is a non-association independent school for young people at key stages 3 and 4.
At Pulse and Water we build resilience in our students; we aim for our students to develop self-regulation.
Pupils’ aspirations for their future lives are supported effectively through a comprehensive careers and employability programme.
Pupils are well cared for. There are strong professional relations between students and staff. This has a strong impact on pupils’ development.

FAQs
How many students are there per class?
We have a maximum capacity of 8 students per class.
What are the closest transport links?
We are fortunate to be a short 10 minute walk from the Abbey Wood, Elizabeth Line and Southeastern Station. We are also a minute walk from Felixstowe Road bus stop where the 177, 469 and N1 stop.
Do you take 16+?
We are registered to support children ages 11 - 18. We are slowly rolling out our 16+ programme which will start with GCSE math and english.
Are there fees?
We are a non-association independent school. For more enquiries about fees please scroll up to access admissions or click the admissions tab at the very top under the menu.
